messages:
maria: Heads-up: ~12 pods in us-central1 stuck Pending for ~20m. Pattern looks like prebind lease hopping + node GPU driver reboots.
jong: can you paste scheduler binder error + node dmesg?
maria: scheduler snippet:
```
E0312 12:10:05.002 binder.go:198] prebind move failed: lease present with different owner (node/gpu-uc1-07 != node/gpu-uc1-03)
W0312 12:10:05.003 backoff.go:62] requeueing pod ml-train-5 after failed prebind
```
node dmesg tail:
```
[ 4203.123456] NVRM: GPU hang: Xid 13, pid=33421
[ 4203.123789] Kernel panic - not syncing: GPU watchdog timeout
[ 4203.123900] Rebooting in 5 seconds...
```
lee: this is the same rebind race we saw in feb. When kubelet dies during the attach, the lease state can be inconsistent and scheduler's prebind controller races to claim. Affinity pins to small-gpu make it try the same island repeatedly -> fragmentation.
maria: warmpool metrics: small-gpu warm hit down from 92% -> 57% in affected AZ; cost estimate shows +18% tokenized reschedule CPU/GPU churn for these jobs.
jong: short triage: 1) cordon gpu-uc1-07 + drain (in-progress) 2) bump prebind timeout config from 4s -> 14s in the scheduler config and roll to canary in us-central1 3) add kubelet-heartbeat check before lease move in MR.
lee: also add exponential backoff on prebind requeues for pods with strict affinity to avoid hot-looping. Maybe 3 retries then fallback to any-compatible placement.
maria: doing drain now. if pods remain Pending after drain, i'll force-delete and let them requeue to warm pool.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0312-0483 created: "us-central1 prebind lease race + GPU watchdog reboots causing Pending pods". Notifying: eng-platform, oncall.
jong: followups: - instrument prebind_handshake_duration histogram - add alert if warm_pool_hit_rate drops >20% in 10m - schedule a driver rollout (canary 5 nodes) after drain to address GPU hangs.
lee: note: implement lease-owner read-after-write check in controller before moving and log owner transitions with previous/next to trace races.
maria: agree. rolling timeout config now to canary. will post update when warm_pool_hit_rate recovers or after forced deletes. thanks all :heart:
